attempts.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-elemental-fire-v3".

Subject and threat:
- Species: elemental.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade not assigned.
- Battlefield duty: bound-frontline-vanguard.
- Construction mode: substance-bodied.
- Fixed chassis: bound-vanguard-elemental.

Identity invariants:
- exactly the headless Bound Vanguard Elemental shown in the neutral chassis benchmark
- fixed broad shallow concave chest with a low stable torso
- fixed broad wedge forearms, short planted legs, and benchmark-matched proportions
- invariant pale arcane sternum core centered inside the chest concavity
- pale binding lattice remains local and does not recolor the full body

Anatomy invariants:
- exactly two arms and two legs
- no head, face, neck, shoulders above the chest, or substitute head-like mass
- exactly five major masses: shallow-concave torso, two wedge arms, and two planted legs
- the declared substance carries the full torso, arm, and leg loads while chassis proportions remain fixed
- every visible flame, plasma tongue, spark, and smoke wisp remains part of the single bounded body presentation and inside the safe frame

Affinity: fire.
Affinity expression: Controlled flame and dense plasma form every load-bearing body mass inside the binding lattice, with minimal dark slag confined to planted contact pads.
Counterplay cue: The pale sternum core and binding lattice become sharply readable between controlled plasma surges.
Altered dimensions: material; motion; attack-telegraph.
Permitted transformations: material; motion; attack telegraph; environmental wake.
Prohibited traits: extra limbs or detached floating body masses; humanoid head, face, helmet, neck, or shoulder-mounted pseudo-head; domed or convex chest replacing the shallow concavity; dark, affinity-colored, absent, displaced, or oversized sternum core; changed chassis proportions, raised heroic posture, or long humanoid legs; rock, lava-rock, charcoal boulders, or stone anatomy with flames pasted on top; large slag shell obscuring the flame-and-plasma body; uniform orange glow that erases the fixed chassis; flame, sparks, smoke, or heat distortion entering the outer eight-percent border.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one full-body Fire Bound Vanguard, deliberately scaled down and centered so its hard chassis plus every flame tip, spark, smoke wisp, and heat-distortion edge remain inside the inner eighty-four percent of the fully finished canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.
- Framing lock: fit every hard extent—including weapon tip, standard, horns, tail, and effect wake—inside the central 84 percent of both canvas dimensions; leave a clearly empty border on all four sides.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/experiments/affinity-workflow-v1/candidates/regression/elemental/fire-v2.png — Previous Fire Bound Vanguard candidate supplies the retained headless chassis and continuous load-bearing flame-and-plasma construction; preserve the design while containing every flame and smoke wisp inside the safe frame.
2. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/benchmarks/bound-vanguard-neutral-anchor-v1.png — Exact Bound Vanguard headless shallow-concave chassis, proportions, planted stance, wedge forearms, and pale sternum core only; do not treat its neutral ceramic material as the affinity substance for non-Normal targets.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.
